correction: The release job created the tag with `gh release create --target` and the job token alone, so a build whose commit changed `.github/workflows/` failed with `HTTP 403: Resource not accessible by integration`: GitHub refuses a tag created this way when the `.github/workflows` tree of the target commit differs from the tree on the default branch, and `GITHUB_TOKEN` cannot get the `workflows` permission. `shared/bootc-secure/ci/create-github-release.sh` now creates the release, classifies that exact 403 by comparing the `.github/workflows` tree identity of the target commit and of the default branch, retries once with the `WORKFLOW_PAT` secret only when the 2 identities differ, and then checks that the tag points at the target commit.
evidence: Run 42143727466 attempts 1 and 2 failed at the Create GitHub Release step and release 2026-11-06.1 is missing. Tag 5fb784b against main 5539a31: `.github/workflows/validate.yml` differs by 1 line (the bats-core bump), so the 2 `.github/workflows` trees differ. All 60 earlier releases had the same `.github/workflows` tree at the tag commit as at main HEAD at release time. test/github-release-create-test.sh checks "a differing workflows tree retries with WORKFLOW_PAT and warns with both tree identities" and "missing WORKFLOW_PAT fails the job with the required secret named" fail without the fix.
